AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro village children
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a village inhabited by kiiro. Like every ordinary kiiro child, [PAWN_nameDef] had a complete and happy childhood.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro good student
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] loves learning and is well liked by the teachers at school.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro tractable child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned early to be frugal and often did chores around the house that she could.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro farm child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Instead of getting an education like the rest of her peers, [PAWN_nameDef] chose to stay home and help take care of the farm.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro shepherd child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] enjoys spending time with animals. Despite her young age, she has become a reliable herder. [PAWN_nameDef] can sing some pastoral songs.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro paper art apprentice
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has been learning paper art since she was young. Her master wanted her to pass on this craft.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro autistic child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is afraid of interacting with people and is always solitude in her room. Being alone gives her a lot of time to think on her own, so maybe [PAWN_nameDef] more deliberate than her peers?

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro orphan
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up relying on the kindness of others; [PAWN_nameDef]'s loved ones left her forever in a disaster when she was young. But after a period of struggle she regained her strength: what does not defeat her will eventually make she stronger.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro imp
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is energetic, although her vivacity always brings trouble to those around her.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro bookworm
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] loved to read books, and she spent all her free time into them, into those endless, varied worlds.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro blacksmith apprentice
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up following around an experienced blacksmith doing some odd jobs. Whenever [PAWN_nameDef] was enthralled by the iron born from the flames and asked her master when she could do it herself, her master would always shudder at the memory of the hammer that [PAWN_nameDef] once almost swung to her head.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro wretch
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] always experienced some unlucky things in her childhood, and it seemed that everything was not going well with her, but after getting used to such a life, [PAWN_nameDef] turned out to be an optimistic person instead.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro left behind child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Both of [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents left her when [PAWN_nameDef] was young, and [PAWN_nameDef] doesn't know where they all went, but [PAWN_nameDef] looks forward to their return every day.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro town child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a town where the level of technology was booming, and the constant introduction of new things fascinated [PAWN_nameDef] all the time, which made her extremely interested in them.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro little genius
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has shown exceptional intelligence since she was young, and her quick and precise logical thinking has always drawn praise from those around her.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: kiiro newsy
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] often helps deliver newspapers for a newspaper office in a small town as a way to get some extra pocket money. Sometimes [PAWN_nameDef] also reads the newspaper by herself, and she learns a lot of things from it that she cannot usually touch.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kiiro Alley Explorer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: To adults, cluttered alleys were boring. To young [PAWN_nameDef], they held secrets and wonders. With feline curiosity and agility, [PAWN_pronoun] sometimes discovers forgotten trinkets in corners and noticed overlooked details. These explorations honed [PAWN_nameDef]'s observation and adaptability.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kiiro Little Adult
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: More mature than peers, [PAWN_nameDef] seems more mature, [PAWN_pronoun] likes helping with chores, like watering plants, tidying toys, staying quiet when parents worked. This precocious responsibility taught [PAWN_pronoun] self-reliance and empathy early.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kiiro Windowsill Watcher
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent childhood on windowsills, watching neighbors, street vendors, and weather changes. This quiet observation shaped [PAWN_possessive] unique worldview and introspective nature. The window was [PAWN_possessive] frame into the world.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kiiro Little Scavenger
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] always scavenges postwar ruins with adults, learning to navigate rubble, spot useful items, and hide from danger. This forced early understanding of survival, sharpening [PAWN_possessive] vigilance and instincts.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kiiro Refugee Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: In makeshift shelters or large families, young kiiro are crowded into "communal sleepnests." [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in such spaces, learning to share and find [PAWN_possessive] place in groups. This fostered [PAWN_possessive] adaptability but limited independence.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kiiro Rooftop Dreamer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Roofs were [PAWN_nameDef]'s childhood haven. There [PAWN_pronoun] overlooked towns, watched smoke curl from chimneys, and gazed at clouds or stars, dreaming freely in [PAWN_possessive] secret aerial kingdom.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kiiro Trouble Magnet
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: For some unknown reasons. Misadventures haunted [PAWN_nameDef]'s youth:spilled ink, shattered flowerpots, being caught where [PAWN_pronoun] shouldn't be. Though not mischievous, trouble found [PAWN_possessive]. These trials honed [PAWN_possessive] adaptability... and apology skills.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kiiro Tiny Taster
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: The kitchen captivated young [PAWN_nameDef]—not for helping, but taking first bites. [PAWN_pronoun] savored Mom's simmering soups or baker's fresh crusts, developing flavor sensitivity and possibly a slightly rounded belly.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kiiro Spice Apprentice
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: If [PAWN_nameDef]'s family traded spices, childhood memories brimmed with aromatic scents and bubbling brews. By helping sort, sun-dry, and grind herbs in small stone mortars. Often leaving [PAWN_possessive] fragrant or sneezing, but taught early in spice knowledge.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kiiro Sweet Hunter
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: To young [PAWN_nameDef], the town sweet shop was paradise. [PAWN_pronoun]'d earn precious morsels—a flaky pastry corner or jewel-like candy—by running errands or deploying their most piteous kitten-eyes at the pastry master. Deepening [PAWN_possessive] love for sugars, honey, and jams. perhaps this inspiring [PAWN_nameDef] for future dessert-making.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kiiro Waterphobic Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Not all kiiro are naturally fond of water. [PAWN_nameDef] had a strong fear of deep, flowing water as a child. Therefore, though living by the river, [PAWN_nameDef] would only play by the shore, finding it much more enjoyable to pile up rocks than to play in the water.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kiiro Reed Captain
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is obsessed with creating things that can float. From large leaves to small rafts made of sturdy reed stalks, [PAWN_nameDef]'s little fleet carries [PAWN_possessive] imagination, sailing on the gentle slopes of the stream.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kiiro Fisherman's Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on a fishing boat. [PAWN_pronoun] would help out with small tasks like organizing fishing lines, fix holes in fishing nets, or carrying buckets of freshly caught fish to the town market.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Kiiro Creekside Playmate
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Most of [PAWN_nameDef]'s childhood was spent by the small creek next to the village. [PAWN_pronoun] enjoyed chasing small fish in shallow water with [PAWN_possessive] friends, flipping over stones to find crabs, or simply sitting quietly by the shore, gently stirring the water's surface with [PAWN_possessive] tail and watching the ripples spread out.
